# A held Jar broken by a bullet leaves its type behind in the player's pickupItemType (851-3473,
# docs/quirks.md §1), and the wiki clip quirks/jar-shot-in-hands. A staged scene (written by wiki-clips

# title's load-level menu (240), and plays the scene's inputs from 241, its frame 0. The player (@) has a Jar
# (j) on his left, a Rock (r) on his right and a Shopkeeper (!) further right:

# He throws the Rock at the Shopkeeper (267), which angers him (279), and picks up the Jar (291), facing him.
# The Shopkeeper's shot breaks it in his hands (318): oJar's collision with oBullet is a bare
# instance_destroy(), and the destroy event clears oPlayer1.pickupItem (a typo) where the whip's break clears
# pickupItemType. So his hands are empty, but pickupItemType is still "Jar", and the HUD keeps drawing the Jar
# (scrDrawHUD). Once he's no longer stunned, the item key switches to a bomb (345), then a rope (349), and then,
# as pickupItemType is the Jar, scrHoldItem gives him a new Jar (353). The next shot knocks it out of his hands
# (355).
# story: held=oRock@259..259 oShopkeeper.status=2@279..279 held=oJar@291..291 -oJar@318..318

# story: held=oRopeThrow@349..349 held=oJar@353..353 +oJar@353..353
